note: A second, independent live run on the same day as structure_benchmark_2026-09-23_summary.json, captured with software_version 2.0.1 (the best_mapping_distribution and attempted_success_rate_percent fixes in CHANGELOG.md 2.0.2 postdate this run). Its raw best_mapping_distribution read {M0:0, M1:0, M2:0, M3:1, M4:67}, summing to 68 against 69 resolved candidates -- one protein that received no usable structure from any provider was silently absent from the table instead of being counted as M0, which is exactly the defect item 1 in 2.0.2 fixes. The corrected distribution below (M0:1) is reconstructed by hand from the arithmetic (resolved - M1 - M2 - M3 - M4), which is the only correction needed; every other field in this file is the provider's unedited output and was already internally consistent (each per_provider.accounting_check was 'ok'). exact_mapping_rate_percent and any_structure_rate_percent were correct in the raw output too, since neither is derived from distribution['M0']. attempted_success_rate_percent did not exist in the script version that produced this run and has been added by hand from the same reconciliation logic now built into the script. A fresh run on 2.0.2 will populate every field natively.
